component.name: Status Hub
component.summary: Application tray items, gathered behind a single panel button

description.p: Status Hub is a StatusNotifierItem tray for the COSMIC desktop. It adds a single chevron button to the panel, pointing at wherever its popup will appear and flipping while the popup is open. Clicking it opens a compact popup holding the tray items, wrapping them onto additional rows when there are many. Nothing else is added to the panel, and the popup is a tray rather than a settings screen.
It is an independent implementation written from the StatusNotifierItem and DBusMenu specifications. It is not a fork of COSMIC's Status Area, and it is built to run alongside it.

The tray is the part of a desktop most exposed to badly behaved applications: they hang, they exit without warning, they answer with the wrong types, and they restart under a new bus name a millisecond after the old one vanished. Status Hub is organised around not letting any of that become your problem:

ul.li: An item exists exactly as long as its bus owner exists, so no leftover icons are stranded when an application exits without unregistering.
Every remote call has a timeout and every item has its own error budget, so one wedged application cannot delay another, or the popup, or the panel.
Every asynchronous reply carries a generation token, so a reply belonging to a process that has already exited can never update its successor.
Ordering is a pure function of discovery order and a small remembered list, never of the order in which replies happened to arrive, so every panel shows the same order.
The applet dies with the panel and is relaunched by it, rebuilding its entire state on every start, so restarting the panel never requires restarting a tray application.

ul.li: Collects StatusNotifierItem tray items behind a single panel button.
Renders DBusMenu menus, including submenus, checkmarks, and radio groups.
Removes items when their bus owner disappears, so no icon is left stranded.
Applies a timeout and a per-item error budget to every remote call.
Keeps a stable item order that does not depend on reply timing.
Runs alongside COSMIC's own Status Area.
